Understanding the yield-curve data

Source: vignettes/articles/Model-parameters.Rmd
Model-parameters.Rmd

RSYC_models contains all published RSYC yield curves from model release v20260923. It has 27,208 rows and 42 columns; each row describes one curve for a forest measure, species, area, and source. The release was built from upstream Git commit c799aba24b5d99a6a7953a4dcab1dd73b0925c2c.

library(RSYC)
head(RSYC_models[c(
  "model_id", "response", "response_units", "strata_level", "strata_id",
  "ecozone_id", "ecoprovince_id", "ecoregion_id", "ecodistrict_id",
  "scale", "species", "b1", "b2", "b3", "b4"
)])
#>                                                                                 model_id
#> 1  rsyc_agb_national_ecoprovince_abie_ama_montane_cordillera_northern_montane_cordillera
#> 2  rsyc_agb_national_ecoprovince_abie_ama_montane_cordillera_southern_montane_cordillera
#> 3             rsyc_agb_national_ecoprovince_abie_ama_pacific_maritime_georgia_depression
#> 4     rsyc_agb_national_ecoprovince_abie_ama_pacific_maritime_southern_coastal_mountains
#> 5 rsyc_agb_national_ecoprovince_abie_bal_atlantic_maritime_appalachian_acadian_highlands
#> 6                 rsyc_agb_national_ecoprovince_abie_bal_atlantic_maritime_fundy_uplands
#>   response response_units strata_level
#> 1      agb          Mg/ha  ecoprovince

#> 3      agb          Mg/ha  ecoprovince
#> 4      agb          Mg/ha  ecoprovince
#> 5      agb          Mg/ha  ecoprovince
#> 6      agb          Mg/ha  ecoprovince
#>                                         strata_id ecozone_id ecoprovince_id

#> 2  Montane Cordillera/Southern Montane Cordillera         14           14.3
#> 3             Pacific Maritime/Georgia Depression         13           13.1
#> 4     Pacific Maritime/Southern Coastal Mountains         13           13.2
#> 5 Atlantic Maritime/Appalachian-Acadian Highlands          7            7.1
#> 6                 Atlantic Maritime/Fundy Uplands          7            7.3

#> 2           NA             NA national ABIE.AMA 197.14596 0.02067093 0.5337509

The response column describes the forest measure: agb is aboveground biomass in Mg/ha, and volume is total volume in m3/ha. Areas can be tiles, ecozones, ecoprovinces, ecoregions, or ecodistricts. The table includes curves fitted across Canada and curves fitted within individual regions. The package functions currently use only the Canada-wide curves.

The four raw hierarchy identifier fields retain upstream codes for ecological areas. ecozone_id, ecoregion_id, and ecodistrict_id are integers; ecoprovince_id is character so codes such as "10.1" retain their source representation. These fields provide data provenance in this release. Ecological model selection uses strata_id, which accepts a numeric/code identifier, an unambiguous short name, or a full hierarchical path. Quote ecoprovince codes such as "10.1" to retain their source representation.

For ecological areas, strata_id gives the full sequence of names from the ecozone down to the selected level, separated by /. predict_rsyc() also accepts the shorter strata_name when that name occurs only once for the chosen forest measure, species, and ecological level:

rsyc_strata(
  response = "agb",
  species = "PICE.MAR",
  strata_level = "ecoregion"
)
#> # A tibble: 116 × 4
#>    strata_level strata_name                   strata_id              strata_code
#>    <chr>        <chr>                         <chr>                  <chr>      
#>  1 ecoregion    Abitibi Plains                Boreal Shield East/Mi… 96         
#>  2 ecoregion    Algonquin-Lake Nipissing      Boreal Shield East/So… 98         
#>  3 ecoregion    Annapolis-Minas Lowlands      Atlantic Maritime/Fun… 126        
#>  4 ecoregion    Anticosti Island              Boreal Shield East/Ea… 102        
#>  5 ecoregion    Appalachians                  Atlantic Maritime/App… 117        
#>  6 ecoregion    Athabasca Plain               Boreal Shield West/We… 87         
#>  7 ecoregion    Atlantic Coast                Atlantic Maritime/Fun… 125        
#>  8 ecoregion    Avalon Forest                 Boreal Shield East/Ne… 115        
#>  9 ecoregion    Big Trout Lake                Boreal Shield West/We… 95         
#> 10 ecoregion    Boreal Mountains and Plateaus Boreal Cordillera/Sou… 180        
#> # ℹ 106 more rows

The discovery result includes the canonical character strata_code. The same value can be supplied through strata_id when exactly one ecological level is selected:

available_rsyc_models(
  response = "agb",
  species = "PICE.MAR",
  strata_level = "ecoprovince",
  strata_id = "7.1"
)
#> # A tibble: 1 × 11
#>   model_id          response response_units strata_type strata_level strata_name
#>   <chr>             <chr>    <chr>          <chr>       <chr>        <chr>      
#> 1 rsyc_agb_nationa… agb      Mg/ha          eco_strata  ecoprovince  Appalachia…
#> # ℹ 5 more variables: strata_id <chr>, strata_code <chr>, species <chr>,
#> #   model_group <chr>, model_version <chr>

Ecozone codes 5, 6, and 10 each correspond to two named subdivisions. Use the desired name for prediction, calibration, or dataset construction; catalogue discovery returns all published matches.

Use available_rsyc_models() to see which curves are available without viewing all of the fields used to fit and check the curves:

available_rsyc_models(
  response = "volume",
  species = "PICE.MAR",
  strata_level = "tile"
)
#> # A tibble: 344 × 11
#>    model_id         response response_units strata_type strata_level strata_name
#>    <chr>            <chr>    <chr>          <chr>       <chr>        <chr>      
#>  1 rsyc_volume_nat… volume   m3/ha          tile        tile         A24        
#>  2 rsyc_volume_nat… volume   m3/ha          tile        tile         A25        
#>  3 rsyc_volume_nat… volume   m3/ha          tile        tile         A26        
#>  4 rsyc_volume_nat… volume   m3/ha          tile        tile         B21        
#>  5 rsyc_volume_nat… volume   m3/ha          tile        tile         B22        
#>  6 rsyc_volume_nat… volume   m3/ha          tile        tile         B23        
#>  7 rsyc_volume_nat… volume   m3/ha          tile        tile         B24        
#>  8 rsyc_volume_nat… volume   m3/ha          tile        tile         B25        
#>  9 rsyc_volume_nat… volume   m3/ha          tile        tile         B26        
#> 10 rsyc_volume_nat… volume   m3/ha          tile        tile         B27        
#> # ℹ 334 more rows
#> # ℹ 5 more variables: strata_id <chr>, strata_code <chr>, species <chr>,
#> #   model_group <chr>, model_version <chr>

RSYC_models also contains measures of uncertainty and variation. local_b1_var and residual_var support local calibration with calibrate_rsyc(); predict_rsyc() itself applies the published coefficients without local adjustment. Because the v20260923 coefficients differ from the previous model release, rendered predictions and calibration examples have been regenerated for this catalogue.
